title.zh: 11.4 圓內接四邊形與四點共圓 · 課本練習
title.en: 11.4 Cyclic Quadrilaterals and Concyclic Points · Book Exercise

intro.zh: 運用圓內接四邊形的對角、外角性質與逆定理，配合圓周角及弧長比例完成證明。
intro.en: Use opposite and exterior angles of cyclic quadrilaterals, their converses, circumference angles and arc ratios.

introSteps.zh: 先確認四點的順序；圓內接四邊形的對角互補，外角等於內對角。
introSteps.en: Check the vertex order: opposite angles are supplementary, and an exterior angle equals the interior opposite angle.

introSteps.zh: 證明四點共圓時，從對角互補、外角等於內對角或同弓形角相等三種方法選擇。
introSteps.en: To prove concyclicity, choose supplementary opposite angles, equal exterior and interior opposite angles, or the converse of the same-segment theorem.

introSteps.zh: 圖中的圓不作證明；依照題目的已知條件推導，每步核對所用角的兩條邊。
introSteps.en: A drawn circle is not a proof. Start from the givens and check the two sides of every angle.

introSteps.zh: 包含課堂練習四題、概念判斷五項及練習第一至三十七題，分數只作練習用途。
introSteps.en: Includes four class exercises, five Section Check statements and Questions 1–37. Practice marks are teacher-set.

title.zh: 對角互補
title.en: Opposite angles are supplementary

body.zh: 同一圓上依次排列的四點形成圓內接四邊形。兩隻對角所對的弧合成整個圓，所以兩角之和為一百八十度。
body.en: Four points in order on a circle form a cyclic quadrilateral. The arcs opposite a pair of opposite angles fill the circle.

caption.zh: 按下一步跟隨推理，上一步及重播可重看。
caption.en: Use Next, Back and Restart to follow and review the reasoning.

steps.zh: 連圓心至對角所對弧的端點：$\alpha+\beta=360^\circ$。
steps.en: Join the centre to the endpoints of the opposite arcs: $\alpha+\beta=360^\circ$.

steps.zh: 每隻圓周角是所對圓心角一半：$\angle BAD=\alpha/2\quad \angle BCD=\beta/2$。
steps.en: Each circumference angle is half its corresponding central angle: $\angle BAD=\alpha/2\quad \angle BCD=\beta/2$.

steps.zh: 兩隻對角之和等於半個周角：$\angle BAD+\angle BCD\quad =(\alpha+\beta)/2=180^\circ$。
steps.en: The opposite-angle sum is half a full turn: $\angle BAD+\angle BCD\quad =(\alpha+\beta)/2=180^\circ$.

intro.zh: 先讀已知條件及點的次序，再按下一步逐項推理。
intro.en: Read the givens and point order, then follow one reason at a time.

title.zh: 外角等於內對角
title.en: Exterior angle equals the interior opposite angle

body.zh: 只延長四邊形的一條邊，所形成的外角等於內對角。若兩條邊都延長，所得角是對頂角，不能直接當作這個外角。
body.en: Extend one side of the quadrilateral. Its exterior angle equals the interior opposite angle. Extending both sides instead gives a vertically opposite angle.

caption.zh: 按下一步跟隨推理，上一步及重播可重看。
caption.en: Use Next, Back and Restart to follow and review the reasoning.

steps.zh: 先用已知圓內接四邊形的對角互補：$\angle ABC+\angle ADC=180^\circ$。
steps.en: Start with supplementary opposite angles in the known cyclic quadrilateral: $\angle ABC+\angle ADC=180^\circ$.

steps.zh: 將 CD 延長至 E，外角與內角互補：$\angle ADE+\angle ADC=180^\circ$。
steps.en: Extend CD to E; the exterior and interior angles are supplementary: $\angle ADE+\angle ADC=180^\circ$.

steps.zh: 兩角都與同一角互補，因此相等：$\angle ADE=\angle ABC$。
steps.en: Angles supplementary to the same angle are equal: $\angle ADE=\angle ABC$.

title.zh: 共圓檢驗一：對角互補
title.en: Concyclicity test 1: supplementary opposite angles

body.zh: 在簡單四邊形中，一對對角互補便足以證明四點共圓。這是判定共圓的逆定理，不能在證明前先引用對角互補性質。
body.en: In a simple quadrilateral, one supplementary opposite pair establishes concyclicity. This is a converse test.

caption.zh: 按下一步跟隨推理，上一步及重播可重看。
caption.en: Use Next, Back and Restart to follow and review the reasoning.

steps.zh: 確認這兩隻角確是對角：$\angle BAD=80^\circ,\quad\angle BCD=100^\circ$。
steps.en: Check that these are opposite angles of the quadrilateral: $\angle BAD=80^\circ,\quad\angle BCD=100^\circ$.

steps.zh: 對角和為平角，使用共圓檢驗：$\angle BAD+\angle BCD=180^\circ$。
steps.en: Their sum is a straight angle, so apply the concyclicity test: $\angle BAD+\angle BCD=180^\circ$.

title.zh: 共圓檢驗二：外角等於內對角
title.en: Concyclicity test 2: exterior equals interior opposite angle

body.zh: 延長一條邊後，若外角等於內對角，則四點共圓。先核對延長方向，尤其不可把對頂角誤作外角。
body.en: If an exterior angle equals the interior opposite angle, the quadrilateral is cyclic. Check the extension direction first.

caption.zh: 按下一步跟隨推理，上一步及重播可重看。
caption.en: Use Next, Back and Restart to follow and review the reasoning.

steps.zh: 確認 CD 延長至 E，標示相等角：$\angle ADE=\angle ABC=x$。
steps.en: Check that CD extends to E and mark the equal angles: $\angle ADE=\angle ABC=x$.

steps.zh: 外角等於內對角，故四點共圓：$\angle ADE=\angle ABC$。
steps.en: Equal exterior and interior opposite angles establish concyclicity: $\angle ADE=\angle ABC$.

title.zh: 共圓檢驗三：同弓形角相等
title.en: Concyclicity test 3: equal angles on the same segment

body.zh: B、C 在弦 AD 同一側；若兩角都對着 AD 且相等，便可使用同弓形角相等的逆定理。角度相等但所對線段不同，並不足夠。
body.en: With B and C on the same side of AD, equal angles ABD and ACD on AD establish concyclicity. Equal angles on different segments are insufficient.

caption.zh: 按下一步跟隨推理，上一步及重播可重看。
caption.en: Use Next, Back and Restart to follow and review the reasoning.

steps.zh: 先找相同線段及位於同一側的頂點：$\angle ABD=\angle ACD=50^\circ$。
steps.en: Identify the same segment and vertices on the same side: $\angle ABD=\angle ACD=50^\circ$.

steps.zh: 相同線段所對角相等，使用逆定理：$\angle ABD=\angle ACD$。
steps.en: Apply the converse same-segment theorem to the equal angles: $\angle ABD=\angle ACD$.

title.zh: 先選四點，再選定理
title.en: Choose four vertices before the theorem

body.zh: 多於四點共圓時，每次只選需要的四點，依照圓周次序找對角。共圓檢驗時先用題目已知、三角形及平行線性質推導；不得把正在證明的共圓當作理由。弧長比例用弧符號，不能換成弦長比例。
body.en: With more than four concyclic points, select four at a time and follow their circular order. In a concyclicity proof, start from givens, triangle properties or parallel lines. Do not assume the conclusion. Use arc symbols for arc ratios; chord ratios do not follow the same rule.

title.zh: 課堂練習
title.en: Class Exercise

stem.zh: ABCD 是圓內接四邊形，CB = CD，C、D、E 共線，$\angle ADE=94^\circ$、$\angle ABD=50^\circ$。
stem.en: ABCD is cyclic, CB = CD and C, D, E are collinear. $\angle ADE=94^\circ$ and $\angle ABD=50^\circ$.

steps.zh: 外角等於內對角，再扣去已知角：$\angle ABC=94^\circ\quad \angle CBD=94^\circ-50^\circ=44^\circ$。
steps.en: Use the cyclic exterior angle, then subtract the given angle: $\angle ABC=94^\circ\quad \angle CBD=94^\circ-50^\circ=44^\circ$.

steps.zh: 等弦形成等腰三角形：$BC=CD\Rightarrow\angle BDC=44^\circ$。
steps.en: Equal chords form an isosceles triangle: $BC=CD\Rightarrow\angle BDC=44^\circ$.

steps.zh: 先求與目標相對頂點的內角：$\angle BCD=180^\circ-44^\circ-44^\circ\quad =92^\circ$。
steps.en: Find the opposite angle first: $\angle BCD=180^\circ-44^\circ-44^\circ\quad =92^\circ$.

steps.zh: 圓內接四邊形的對角互補：$\angle DAB=180^\circ-92^\circ=88^\circ$。
steps.en: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary: $\angle DAB=180^\circ-92^\circ=88^\circ$.

stem.zh: ABCD 在以 BC 為直徑的半圓上。DB 平分 $\angle ABC$，且 $\angle ADB=22^\circ$。
stem.en: ABCD lie on the semicircle with diameter BC. DB bisects $\angle ABC$ and $\angle ADB=22^\circ$.

steps.zh: 直徑所對的圓周角是直角：$\angle BDC=90^\circ$。
steps.en: The diameter subtends a right angle: $\angle BDC=90^\circ$.

steps.zh: 把角平分線兩旁設為同一未知量：$\angle ABD=\angle CBD=x\quad \angle ADC=22^\circ+90^\circ=112^\circ$。
steps.en: Use one variable for the bisected angle: $\angle ABD=\angle CBD=x\quad \angle ADC=22^\circ+90^\circ=112^\circ$.

steps.zh: 對角互補後解方程：$2x+112^\circ=180^\circ\quad x=34^\circ$。
steps.en: Use supplementary opposite angles and solve: $2x+112^\circ=180^\circ\quad x=34^\circ$.

stem.zh: AC 與 BD 相交於 E。$\angle ABC=60^\circ$、$\angle ACB=39^\circ$、$\angle ACD=24^\circ$、$\angle AED=105^\circ$。
stem.en: AC and BD meet at E. $\angle ABC=60^\circ$, $\angle ACB=39^\circ$, $\angle ACD=24^\circ$ and $\angle AED=105^\circ$.

parts.zh: 證明 A、B、C、D 四點共圓。
parts.en: Prove that A, B, C and D are concyclic.

steps.zh: 交叉直線的對頂角相等：$\angle BEC=\angle AED=105^\circ$。
steps.en: Use vertically opposite angles: $\angle BEC=\angle AED=105^\circ$.

steps.zh: 在三角形中扣去兩隻已知角：$\angle CBE=180^\circ-39^\circ-105^\circ\quad =36^\circ$。
steps.en: Subtract the two known angles in the triangle: $\angle CBE=180^\circ-39^\circ-105^\circ\quad =36^\circ$.

steps.zh: 從整角扣去剛求出的部分：$\angle ABD=60^\circ-36^\circ=24^\circ$。
steps.en: Subtract this part from the whole angle: $\angle ABD=60^\circ-36^\circ=24^\circ$.

steps.zh: 同一弦所對的角相等，使用逆定理：$\angle ABD=\angle ACD=24^\circ$。
steps.en: Equal angles on the same chord establish concyclicity: $\angle ABD=\angle ACD=24^\circ$.

title.zh: 概念判斷
title.en: Section Check

stem.zh: 依照對應字母的圖，判斷各命題是否正確。
stem.en: Decide whether each statement is correct using its corresponding lettered figure.

parts.label: (a)
parts.zh: 圖 (a)：ABCD 共圓，$\theta=\angle BCD$。若 $\angle BAD=2\angle BCD$，則 $\theta=60^\circ$。
parts.en: Figure (a): ABCD is cyclic and $\theta=\angle BCD$. If $\angle BAD=2\angle BCD$, then $\theta=60^\circ$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.zh: 圖 (b)：ABCD 共圓，ADF、CDE 都是直線，則 $\angle ABC=\angle EDF$。
parts.en: Figure (b): ABCD is cyclic and ADF and CDE are straight lines. Then $\angle ABC=\angle EDF$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.zh: 圖 (c)：若 $\triangle ABD\cong\triangle CBD$，則 ABCD 共圓。
parts.en: Figure (c): If $\triangle ABD\cong\triangle CBD$, then ABCD is cyclic.

parts.label: (d)
parts.zh: 圖 (d)：AC 與 BD 相交於 E。若 AB // DC，則 A、B、C、D 共圓。
parts.en: Figure (d): AC and BD meet at E. If AB // DC, then A, B, C and D are concyclic.

parts.label: (e)
parts.zh: 所有長方形都是圓內接四邊形。

title.zh: 對角互補，解一元方程
title.en: Use supplementary opposite angles and solve

steps.zh: 對角互補，解一元方程：$2\theta+\theta=180^\circ\quad \theta=60^\circ$。
steps.en: Use supplementary opposite angles and solve: $2\theta+\theta=180^\circ\quad \theta=60^\circ$.

title.zh: 兩邊同時延長所得的是對頂角
title.en: Extending both sides creates a vertically opposite angle

steps.zh: 兩邊同時延長所得的是對頂角：$\angle ADC=\angle EDF\quad \angle ABC+\angle EDF=180^\circ$。
steps.en: Extending both sides creates a vertically opposite angle: $\angle ADC=\angle EDF\quad \angle ABC+\angle EDF=180^\circ$.

title.zh: 全等只能推出兩角相等，不能保證互補
title.en: Congruence gives equality but does not guarantee supplementary angles

steps.zh: 全等只能推出兩角相等，不能保證互補：$\angle BAD=\angle BCD\quad \angle BAD+\angle BCD\ne180^\circ\text{ in general}$。
steps.en: Congruence gives equality but does not guarantee supplementary angles: $\angle BAD=\angle BCD\quad \angle BAD+\angle BCD\ne180^\circ\text{ in general}$.
steps.math: \angle BAD=\angle BCD\quad \angle BAD+\angle BCD\ne180^\circ\text{ in general}

title.zh: 只有一對平行邊不足以證共圓
title.en: One pair of parallel sides is insufficient for concyclicity

steps.zh: 只有一對平行邊不足以證共圓：$AB\,//\,DC\not\Rightarrow A,B,C,D\text{ concyclic}$。
steps.en: One pair of parallel sides is insufficient for concyclicity: $AB\,//\,DC\not\Rightarrow A,B,C,D\text{ concyclic}$.

title.zh: 長方形的對角均為直角
title.en: Opposite angles of a rectangle are right angles

steps.zh: 長方形的對角均為直角：$90^\circ+90^\circ=180^\circ$。
steps.en: Opposite angles of a rectangle are right angles: $90^\circ+90^\circ=180^\circ$.

stem.zh: ABCD 是圓內接四邊形，$\angle ABC=62^\circ$、$\angle BCD=86^\circ$。圖中 $x=\angle ADC$、$y=\angle BAD$。
stem.en: ABCD is cyclic, $\angle ABC=62^\circ$ and $\angle BCD=86^\circ$. Here $x=\angle ADC$ and $y=\angle BAD$.

steps.zh: 先配對位於相對頂點的角：$x+62^\circ=180^\circ\quad x=118^\circ$。
steps.en: Pair the angles at opposite vertices: $x+62^\circ=180^\circ\quad x=118^\circ$.

steps.zh: 另一對對角也互補：$y+86^\circ=180^\circ\quad y=94^\circ$。
steps.en: The other opposite pair is also supplementary: $y+86^\circ=180^\circ\quad y=94^\circ$.

steps.zh: 先用對角互補求底角：$\angle ABC=180^\circ-111^\circ=69^\circ$。

steps.zh: 用三角形內角和求頂角：$x=180^\circ-69^\circ-69^\circ=42^\circ$。

steps.en: Use the other exterior angle and its interior opposite angle: $y=\angle BAD=\angle DCQ=89^\circ$.

steps.zh: 從相等的整段扣去相等部分：$AB=BE-AE\quad CD=CE-DE=BE-AE=AB$。

title.zh: 鈍圓周角對應圓心反角
title.en: The obtuse circumference angle corresponds to a reflex centre angle

steps.zh: 鈍圓周角對應圓心反角：$\text{reflex }\angle AOC=2(105^\circ)=210^\circ$。
steps.en: The obtuse circumference angle corresponds to a reflex centre angle: $\text{reflex }\angle AOC=2(105^\circ)=210^\circ$.

title.zh: 圓心四周角度總和為三百六十度
title.en: Angles around the centre sum to a full turn

steps.zh: 圓心四周角度總和為三百六十度：$\angle AOC=360^\circ-210^\circ=150^\circ$。
steps.en: Angles around the centre sum to a full turn: $\angle AOC=360^\circ-210^\circ=150^\circ$.

title.zh: 檢驗四邊形 ADCO 的對角
title.en: Test opposite angles of quadrilateral ADCO

steps.zh: 檢驗四邊形 ADCO 的對角：$\angle AOC+\angle ADC\quad =150^\circ+30^\circ=180^\circ$。
steps.en: Test opposite angles of quadrilateral ADCO: $\angle AOC+\angle ADC\quad =150^\circ+30^\circ=180^\circ$.

stem.zh: A、B、C、D、E 在同一圓上，$\angle BAE=102^\circ$、$\angle CDE=126^\circ$。
stem.en: A, B, C, D and E lie on a circle, $\angle BAE=102^\circ$ and $\angle CDE=126^\circ$.

steps.zh: 先用四邊形 ABCE 的對角：$\angle BCE=180^\circ-102^\circ=78^\circ$。
steps.en: Use opposite angles in quadrilateral ABCE: $\angle BCE=180^\circ-102^\circ=78^\circ$.

steps.zh: 再用四邊形 BCDE 的對角：$\angle CBE=180^\circ-126^\circ=54^\circ$。
steps.en: Use opposite angles in quadrilateral BCDE: $\angle CBE=180^\circ-126^\circ=54^\circ$.

steps.zh: 三角形 BCE 的第三角就是所求：$\angle BEC=180^\circ-78^\circ-54^\circ\quad =48^\circ$。
steps.en: The third angle of triangle BCE is the target: $\angle BEC=180^\circ-78^\circ-54^\circ\quad =48^\circ$.

stem.zh: ABCD 是圓內接四邊形，ADF、BAE、BCF、CDE 都是直線。$\angle EDF=124^\circ$，$x=\angle DFC$。
stem.en: ABCD is cyclic. ADF, BAE, BCF and CDE are straight lines. $\angle EDF=124^\circ$ and $x=\angle DFC$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.en: Express $\angle DAE$ in terms of x.

parts.label: (b)
parts.zh: 若 A、C、F、E 共圓，求 x。
parts.en: If A, C, F and E are concyclic, find x.

steps.zh: 利用三角形外角列出含未知量的角：$\angle DCF=124^\circ-x$。
steps.en: Express the angle using a triangle exterior angle: $\angle DCF=124^\circ-x$.

steps.zh: 圓內接四邊形的外角等於內對角：$\angle BAD=\angle DCF=124^\circ-x$。
steps.en: Use the cyclic exterior-angle property: $\angle BAD=\angle DCF=124^\circ-x$.

steps.zh: 再由直線鄰角求第一問：$\angle DAE=180^\circ-(124^\circ-x)\quad =56^\circ+x$。
steps.en: Use adjacent angles on a straight line for part (a): $\angle DAE=180^\circ-(124^\circ-x)\quad =56^\circ+x$.

steps.zh: 加入第二問的四點共圓條件：$\angle DAE=\angle DCF\quad 56^\circ+x=124^\circ-x$。
steps.en: Add the concyclicity condition in part (b): $\angle DAE=\angle DCF\quad 56^\circ+x=124^\circ-x$.

steps.zh: 解一元方程求出題目的未知角：$2x=68^\circ\quad x=34^\circ$。
steps.en: Solve the equation for the unknown angle: $2x=68^\circ\quad x=34^\circ$.

stem.zh: ABCF 與 CDEF 分別為圓內接四邊形。A、F、E 及 B、C、D 各自共線。

steps.zh: 先用左圓的外角性質：$\angle DCF=\angle BAF$。

steps.zh: 右邊圓內接四邊形的對角互補：$\angle DEF+\angle DCF=180^\circ$。
steps.en: Opposite angles in the right circle are supplementary: $\angle DEF+\angle DCF=180^\circ$.

steps.zh: 同旁內角互補，故兩直線平行：$\angle BAF+\angle DEF=180^\circ\quad AB\,//\,ED$。

title.en: Level 2

stem.zh: O 是圓心，OC 與 BD 相交於 E，$\angle BAD=72^\circ$、$\angle BOC=106^\circ$。
stem.en: O is the centre. OC and BD meet at E, $\angle BAD=72^\circ$ and $\angle BOC=106^\circ$.

steps.zh: 連半徑，利用同弧圓心角是圓周角兩倍：$\angle BOD=2(72^\circ)=144^\circ$。
steps.en: Join the radius and double the circumference angle on the same arc: $\angle BOD=2(72^\circ)=144^\circ$.

steps.zh: 從整隻圓心角扣去已知的部分：$\angle COD=144^\circ-106^\circ=38^\circ$。
steps.en: Subtract the given central angle: $\angle COD=144^\circ-106^\circ=38^\circ$.

steps.zh: 用半徑相等求第一問：$OC=OD\quad \angle OCD=(180^\circ-38^\circ)/2\quad =71^\circ$。
steps.en: Use equal radii to solve part (a): $OC=OD\quad \angle OCD=(180^\circ-38^\circ)/2\quad =71^\circ$.
steps.ref: (radii of the same circle); (base ∠s, isos. △); (∠ sum of △)

steps.zh: 另一個等腰三角形給出小底角：$OB=OD\quad \angle OBD=(180^\circ-144^\circ)/2\quad =18^\circ$。
steps.en: Use the other isosceles triangle to find a small base angle: $OB=OD\quad \angle OBD=(180^\circ-144^\circ)/2\quad =18^\circ$.
steps.ref: (radii of the same circle); (base ∠s, isos. △); (∠ sum of △)

steps.zh: 外角等於兩隻內對角之和：$\angle OED=\angle BOE+\angle OBE\quad =106^\circ+18^\circ=124^\circ$。
steps.en: The exterior angle equals the sum of the two interior opposite angles: $\angle OED=\angle BOE+\angle OBE\quad =106^\circ+18^\circ=124^\circ$.

steps.zh: 用三角形內角和求第一問：$\angle ADE=180^\circ-112^\circ-18^\circ\quad =50^\circ$。

steps.zh: 等弦所對的對應圓周角相等：$AB=AE\Rightarrow\angle ACB=\angle ADE\quad =50^\circ$。

steps.zh: 先把倍數條件化成最簡弧長比：$\overset{\frown}{PQ}:\overset{\frown}{QR}:\overset{\frown}{RS}\quad =1:1:2$。

parts.zh: 三角形 BCD 是否等邊三角形？解釋答案。

steps.zh: 設圓周角，用同弧圓心角兩倍關係：$\angle ACB=t\quad \angle AOB=2t$。
steps.en: Name the circumference angle and use the doubled central angle: $\angle ACB=t\quad \angle AOB=2t$.

steps.zh: 用題目給出的另一組四點共圓：$\angle ADB=\angle AOB=2t$。

steps.en: All three triangle angles are equal, so the triangle is equilateral: $3t=180^\circ\quad \angle BCD=\angle CBD=\angle BDC=60^\circ$.

steps.zh: 內心在角平分線上：$\angle CAD=\angle BAC=18^\circ\quad \angle BAD=36^\circ$。

steps.zh: 同弓形內的兩隻圓周角相等：$\angle BED=\angle BAD=36^\circ$。

steps.zh: 等腰三角形的底角相等：$AF=EF\Rightarrow\angle EAF=54^\circ$。

steps.en: Combine the supplementary interior angles to prove parallel lines: $\angle BAE+\angle AED\quad =(18^\circ+18^\circ+54^\circ)+90^\circ\quad =180^\circ\Rightarrow AB\,//\,ED$.
